judgment.rationale: A delayed placement event may apply history after the user has manually zoned a new window, or another placement mechanism may be active. Reproduce with the setting off before selecting which event guard to change.

plan: Use two equal zones and Explorer plus a simple multi-instance text editor; disable automatic last-zone placement and record the saved setting.

Compare enabled versus disabled setting, and programmatic versus manual movement to identify which delayed event moves it.
